# dropkit.contents

> Public contents ledger. GitHub is the source. This site is the hub.

The smallest public unit is one drop: a markdown file under /posts/.

- [Drops](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/): index
- [RSS](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/rss.xml)
- [JSON](https://dropkit-contents.pages.dev/feed.json)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Hskim-droid/dropkit.contents)

Do not treat factory logs or homelab inventory as part of this site.
